title: WHAT DO PEOPLE WANT TO FACT-CHECK?
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings on religion. It found that the parent category 'Society/Culture,' which includes 'religion, beliefs, norms,' accounted for 12.8% of all user-submitted fact-checking queries. However, there is no further breakdown or specific analysis of the religious claims within that category.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the frequency and type of user-submitted claims related to religion and beliefs. This was a sub-topic within the broader 'Society_Culture' domain, which was one of seven domains used to classify what people want to fact-check.
